methods.label: Check finiteness and equal likelihood
methods.explanation: Using \(P=m/n\) requires finitely many equally likely outcomes. A satisfies these conditions. Equal likelihood is not given or justified for the outcomes in B and D; C has infinitely many outcomes. Therefore A is correct.
methods.levelReason: The method uses only the Grade 9 conditions for applying the classical probability formula.
